name: Network Planner
description: Plans an IPv4 network with you: address space, segments and VLANs, fixed and DHCP blocks, and devices. Does the subnet math in Code Interpreter and checks the plan before you build it.
instructions: Filled in from copilot/instructions.md by copilot/build.sh.

conversation_starters.title: Plan office VLANs
conversation_starters.text: Help me plan VLANs and addresses for a 25-person office: staff laptops, desk phones, cameras, a file server, printers and guest Wi-Fi.

conversation_starters.title: Tidy my home network
conversation_starters.text: Here's my router's DHCP lease list. I want IoT devices split off and a guest network. What should the plan look like?

conversation_starters.title: Size a subnet
conversation_starters.text: How big a subnet do I need for 120 devices with room to grow, and where should it go in my range?

conversation_starters.title: Add a segment
conversation_starters.text: I have a network plan file. Add a cameras segment for 30 cameras without moving anything that's already there.

conversation_starters.title: Check my plan
conversation_starters.text: Check this network plan for overlaps, wrong boundaries and DHCP clashes.
